DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 練習の輪へ入ってみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to join the practice circle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入りたいです。途中から来たので動きが分からず、真ん中へ立てば教わりやすいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中到着で動き不明の盆踊りへ参加したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would. I arrived partway through and do not know the movements, so I thought standing in the middle would make it easier to learn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to join the Bon dance after arriving partway through without knowing the movements. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 輪の外から、まず一度動きをご覧ください。次の曲からこちらへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First watch the movements once from outside the circle. You can join here from the next song.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外で見ます。踊っている人の前へ割り込まず、この入口から次の曲に参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まず外から見て曲の切れ目から入ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will watch from outside. I will not cut in front of the dancers; I will join the next song through this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to watch from outside first and join at the break between songs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 教える方の足元が見える位置へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will show you a spot where you can see the instructor's feet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 足の動きが見えました。全部を一度に真似しようとせず、まず同じ方向へ動く所から覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 足元を見て同方向移動から覚える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I could see the foot movements. Rather than try to copy everything at once, I will first learn to move in the same direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Watch the feet and begin by learning to move in the same direction. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中で休む時は、次の方が入れるよう輪の外へ移ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: When taking a break, please move outside the circle so the next person can join.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一曲踊れました。少し息を整えるので外へ出ます。この入口は次の方が使えるよう空けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一曲後に息を整えるため退出し参加入口を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I managed to dance one song. I will step outside to catch my breath. I will keep this entrance clear for the next person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After one song, leave to catch your breath and keep the entrance clear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もう一度参加する時は、こちらから声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you want to join again, please speak to us from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休んでから声をかけます。次に入る時も、曲の途中へ飛び込まず、入れる所を教わって参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再参加は職員へ声をかけ切れ目から入ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will speak to you after resting. Next time too, I will not jump in during a song; I will ask where I can enter before joining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will speak to staff before rejoining and enter at a break. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一緒に踊ってくださりありがとうございます。それでは、また後の曲でお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for dancing with us. We look forward to seeing you again for a later song.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 長いお荷物の扱いで、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about handling long luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 釣り竿を持っています。着いたらすぐ使いたくて、ホームで伸ばそうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ホームで釣り竿を伸ばそうとしていたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a fishing rod. I wanted to use it as soon as I arrived, so I was about to extend it on the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice, explaining that you were about to extend a fishing rod on the platform. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここで長く広げると、通る方に当たるおそれがあります。収納したままにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Extending it here could hit people passing by. Please keep it packed away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ伸ばしていません。袋のまま持ち、釣り場へ着いてから用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未伸長で収納のまま運び釣り場で準備すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not extended it yet. I will carry it in its bag and prepare it after reaching the fishing spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is not extended and decide to carry it packed and prepare it at the fishing spot. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先端も外へ出ていないか、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check that the tip is not sticking out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先が少し見えていました。自分の袋へきちんと入れ直し、肩の高さで横に振らないように持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 突出先端を袋へ入れ横振りを避けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: A little of the tip was showing. I will put it properly back in my bag and carry it without swinging it sideways at shoulder height.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the protruding tip into the bag and avoid swinging it sideways. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車内では、ほかの方の足元へ倒れないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: On the train, please make sure it does not fall at other people's feet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 席へ横に置かず、自分で支えて運びます。友人にも、列車の中で仕掛けを付け始めないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車内支えと同行者へ仕掛け準備延期を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will support it myself as I carry it rather than lay it sideways on a seat. I will also tell my friend not to start attaching fishing tackle on the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will support it on the train and tell your companion to postpone preparing the tackle. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 釣り場までの道のご案内も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also need directions to the fishing spot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道は友人と調べました。駅では竿を準備するのでなく、収納状態を保って乗り、降りてから広げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道確認済みで到着後にのみ竿を広げると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend and I looked up the route. Rather than prepare the rod at the station, I will keep it packed while boarding and open it out after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the route has been checked and that you will extend the rod only after arrival. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お荷物に気をつけてお進みください。ご旅行をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed carefully with your luggage. Enjoy your trip. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内の地図でお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 健康づくりの会場まで歩きたいのですが、地図には駅から十分とあります。私の家からも十分と考えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅起点の徒歩十分が自宅からも同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to walk to the health promotion event venue, but the map says ten minutes from the station. Can I assume it is also ten minutes from my home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ten-minute walk measured from the station also applies from home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その時間は駅を出発する場合です。ご自宅の場所は、この地図のどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That time is for starting at the station. Where is your home on this map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この商店街の先です。駅とは反対側なので、同じ出発点ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅位置を示し出発点相違を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beyond this shopping street. It is on the opposite side from the station, so the starting point is different, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your home's location and acknowledge the different starting point. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 詳しい歩行時間は、ご自身の速さや経路でも変わります。会場の場所をまず確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The exact walking time also depends on your pace and route. Let us first confirm the venue's location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 場所は分かりました。初回に遅れないよう、前日に途中まで歩いて道を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会場確認後に前日下見をしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I know where it is now. To avoid being late for the first session, I would like to walk partway there the day before to check the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After confirming the venue, say that you want to check the route the day before. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の受付に、余裕を持ってお越しください。途中で休める場所もご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please allow plenty of time to arrive for reception on the day. Also check for yourself where you can rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いつもより早めに家を出ます。駅の表示時間を自宅からの約束の時間として家族へ伝えるのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 余裕ある出発と家族へ確約時間を言わない方針を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave home earlier than usual. I will also stop telling my family that the time shown from the station is a guaranteed time from my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave with time to spare and will not give your family a guaranteed travel time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開催の曜日と会場名は、こちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The day of the week and venue name are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会場名と曜日を控えました。歩く道と休める所を調べてから参加し、駅からの時間とは分けて予定を組みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 曜日会場を控え自宅経路と休憩を調べ参加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noted the venue name and day of the week. I will check the walking route and resting places before participating, and plan separately from the time stated from the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the day and venue, check the route from home and resting places, and then participate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご参加をお待ちしております。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to your participation. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お休みの姿勢で、気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything concerning you about your resting position?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この本を読んでいましたが、腕が疲れて胸の方へ落ちそうです。無理に持ち続けず、いったん閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い本を持つ腕が疲れ落下しそうで読書を中断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was reading this book, but my arms are tired and it is about to fall onto my chest. I will close it for now instead of forcing myself to keep holding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop reading because your arms are tired from holding a heavy book and it might fall. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 閉じた本をお預かりして、手の届く所へ置きましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shall I take the closed book and put it within your reach?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。ベッドの上へ立てかけるのでなく、横の台へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本を横台へ置く補助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. Please put it on the stand beside me rather than prop it up on the bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for help putting the book on the side stand. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの台へ置きます。読みたい時の姿勢も担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will put it on this stand. You can also ask the person in charge about a position for reading.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読みたい気持ちはありますが、今は休みたいです。ベッドの設定を自分で変えて座るのは、説明を受けてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今は休みベッド操作は説明後にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do want to read, but right now I want to rest. I will wait until I have had an explanation before changing the bed settings myself to sit up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will rest now and operate the bed only after receiving an explanation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み始める際にお声がけください。お持ちの本は大きいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please call us when you start reading. Your book is large, isn't it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図鑑なので重いです。家族が来たら薄い本に替えてもらいますが、家族が来るまでは今の本を無理に持って読みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薄い本への変更を家族に頼み重い本を無理に読まないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is an illustrated reference book, so it is heavy. When my family comes, I will ask them to replace it with a thin book, but until then I will not force myself to hold this book and read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to ask your family for a thinner book and not force yourself to read the heavy one. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な物があれば、手を伸ばす前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need anything, let us know before reaching for it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 呼出しのボタンはここにあります。姿勢を変えてまた読む時は声をかけ、今はいったん目も休めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 呼出し位置を確認し再開時に姿勢相談する予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The call button is here. When I change position and read again, I will call you; for now I will rest my eyes too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm where the call button is and say that you will consult about your position when resuming. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ごゆっくりお休みください。本はこちらにあります。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please rest comfortably. Your book is here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の合図の練習を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will begin practicing bicycle signals.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。向かいの人の動きを真似すると、自分の右と左を取り違えそうです。先に自分の向きで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 向かいの人の模倣で左右を混同しそうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. If I copy someone facing me, I might mix up my right and left. I would like to check from my own direction first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that copying a person facing you may cause you to mix up left and right. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 向かいからではなく、同じ向きで見られる場所へ移りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us move somewhere you can watch facing the same direction rather than opposite each other.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらなら先生と同じ向きですね。まず立ったまま自分の右側を確認して、どの動きを学ぶか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同方向の場所へ移り自分の右を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here I am facing the same direction as the instructor. First, while standing still, I will check my own right side and ask which movement we will learn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move to face the same direction and check your own right side. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 動きは順に説明します。自転車に乗ってから、急に腕を振り始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the movements in order. Please do not suddenly start waving your arms once you get on the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自転車は置いたままで練習します。友人の前へ手を伸ばして当てないよう、少し間隔を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車前の静止練習と周囲間隔を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will practice with the bicycle left parked. I will leave some space so I do not reach in front of my friend and hit them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose stationary practice before riding and leave space around you. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず説明を聞いてから、一つずつ確認してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: First listen to the explanation, then try checking one movement at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の動きはできました。左右が分かっただけで道路での合図全部を覚えたとは思わず、続きも教わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一動作成功だけで全合図習得とはせず次説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I could do that movement. I will not think I have learned all road signals just because I understand left and right; I would like to learn the rest too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not regard one successful movement as learning all signals; ask for the next explanation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合図と走行の練習は、この後の担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next person in charge will guide you through signaling and riding practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当の順番で続けます。反対向きの人を見て左右を取り違えないよう、自分の向きに戻って確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同方向で再確認し担当の練習順に従う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will continue in the order the instructor gives. To avoid mixing up left and right while watching someone facing the opposite way, I will return to my own direction and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check again facing the same direction and follow the instructor's practice order. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その方法で練習しましょう。それでは、次の担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us practice that way. I will show you to the next person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受取りの日時について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the date and time for receiving your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の昼間は仕事です。送り主から発送したと連絡が来たので、受け取れる時間に合わせて希望を出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼間勤務のため発送済荷物の受取時間指定を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I work during the daytime next week. The sender told me the parcel has been sent, so I want to request a time when I can receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a delivery time for an already shipped parcel because you work during the day. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物を特定する番号は、お分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the number that identifies the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内にあります。火曜の夜か水曜の朝なら在宅できます。送り主へ希望を言っただけで、配達の指定はまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号と火夜水朝の在宅候補を示し未指定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is in this notice. I can be home Tuesday evening or Wednesday morning. I have only told the sender my preference and have not specified the delivery time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the number and possible times Tuesday evening or Wednesday morning, and say no time has been specified yet. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この荷物で受け付けられる希望を確認します。火曜の夜は選べますが、水曜の朝は現在の案内では選べません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check which requests we can accept for this parcel. You can choose Tuesday evening, but according to the current information you cannot choose Wednesday morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら火曜の夜を希望します。水曜の朝に来るつもりで仕事を遅らせる必要はありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 選択可能な火夜を選び水朝の予定を残さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like Tuesday evening. So I do not need to delay going to work on the assumption it will arrive Wednesday morning, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the available Tuesday evening option and do not keep plans for Wednesday morning. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 火曜の夜の希望を受け付けます。受付の結果をこちらでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will accept your request for Tuesday evening. Please check the result here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 火曜の夜になっています。番号と日時を控えました。家族にもその時間は在宅する予定だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付結果を照合し番号日時を控え家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says Tuesday evening. I noted the number and date and time. I will also tell my family that I plan to be home then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the accepted request, note the number and date and time, and tell your family. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご予定が変わった場合は、利用案内から変更の方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your plans change, please check the user guide for how to make changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の予定では受け取れます。もし勤務が変わったら、希望した時間の前に変更できる方法を調べて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務変更時は変更方法確認と事前連絡を予定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can receive it with my current schedule. If my work schedule changes, I will check how to change the request before the requested time and contact you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Plan to check the change procedure and contact them in advance if your work schedule changes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、受付の内容をお持ちください。ご希望を確認しました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the details of the accepted request. We have confirmed your preference. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 旅行後の外貨の両替をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to exchange foreign currency left after your trip, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。米ドルの十ドル札が二枚と、少し硬貨があります。こちらで扱える物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残外貨の十ドル二枚と硬貨の取扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have two ten-dollar US bills and a few coins. Please tell me which you can handle here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about exchanging two remaining ten-dollar bills and coins. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日は米ドルの紙幣を扱います。硬貨はお取扱いがないので、別にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today we handle US dollar banknotes. We do not handle coins, so please keep them separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 硬貨は袋へ分けました。十ドル札二枚、合計二十ドルだけを両替します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 硬貨を分け二十ドル紙幣のみ両替を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I separated the coins into a bag. I will exchange only the two ten-dollar bills, totaling twenty dollars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the coins and ask to exchange only twenty dollars in banknotes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の案内では一ドル百五十円で、二十ドルが三千円になります。費用百円を引いて、お渡しするのは二千九百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this transaction, the quoted rate is 150 yen per dollar, making twenty dollars 3,000 yen. After deducting a 100-yen fee, we will give you 2,900 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二千九百円を受け取る内容ですね。その説明でお願いします。硬貨は次の旅行用に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 例示レート費用と手取二千九百円を確認し受け入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I will receive 2,900 yen. Please proceed on those terms. I will take the coins home for my next trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm and accept the quoted rate, fee, and net receipt of 2,900 yen. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙幣の確認と必要な受付を済ませて、こちらでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the bills, complete the necessary procedures, and give you the money here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付の内容を確認しました。二十ドルの紙幣を渡し、二千九百円と控えを受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付内容を照合し紙幣と円控えの交換を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked the transaction details. I will hand over twenty dollars in banknotes and receive 2,900 yen and the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the transaction details and ask to exchange the bills for yen and a receipt. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが円と控えです。お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the yen and receipt. Please check them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二千九百円あり、控えの二十ドルと費用百円も一致しています。硬貨の袋も手元にあるので、これで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取額と控え元本費用を照合し硬貨袋保持を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is 2,900 yen, and the twenty dollars and 100-yen fee on the receipt match too. I also still have the bag of coins, so everything is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the received amount with the principal and fee on the receipt and confirm you still have the coin bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの魚をお選びになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to choose this fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 丸ごとの魚に興味がありますが、家の包丁は小さい物だけです。買ってから自分でさばけないと困りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 丸魚を買いたいが自宅包丁で処理困難を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am interested in a whole fish, but I only have a small knife at home. I might have trouble if I buy it and cannot prepare it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about buying a whole fish when your home knife makes preparation difficult. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売場では下処理できる品があります。どの料理に使いたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some items at this counter can be prepared for you. What dish would you like to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼いて食べたいです。写真で見た丸焼きにこだわるより、家の道具で扱える形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丸焼きへの拘りより家で扱える焼魚用形を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to grill it. Rather than insist on the whole grilled fish I saw in a photo, I want it in a form I can handle with my utensils at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a form suitable for grilling at home rather than insisting on grilling it whole. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの品なら、切り身にするご希望を伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this fish, we can take a request to cut it into portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切り身をお願いします。頭や骨まで家で料理する予定はないので、受取りの内容も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切り身を頼み頭骨の受取内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please cut it into portions. I do not plan to cook the head or bones at home, so please also tell me what I will receive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request portions and ask whether the head and bones will be included. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切り身だけのお渡しと、残りを一緒にお渡しする形を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose to receive only the portions or to receive the rest along with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は切り身だけにします。家で使うフライパンへ入りやすい大きさでお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切り身のみを選び自宅フライパンに合う大きさを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will take only the portions. Could you make them a size that fits easily into my frying pan at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose only the portions and ask about a size that fits your home frying pan. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 下処理には少しお時間をいただきます。こちらの番号をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Preparation will take a little time. Please keep this number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を受け取りました。切り身だけで注文したので、別の魚を重ねて買わず、仕上がった品を確認して受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 処理番号を受け取り注文内容を保ち仕上品を受取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the number. Since I ordered only portions, I will not buy another fish as well; I will check and collect the prepared item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the preparation number, keep the order as requested, and collect the finished item. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、売場を回ってお待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please browse the sales area while you wait. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃の一区切りがつきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you reached a stopping point in the cleaning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人に休憩へ呼ばれましたが、拾った袋を自分の物と一緒に置いたまま離れてよいか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃後の休憩前に回収袋の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend called me to take a break, but I am wondering whether it is all right to leave the bag of collected litter together with my own belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before taking a break after cleaning, check how to handle the collected bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 回収する袋は受付へ渡してください。ご自身の荷物とは分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please hand the collection bag to reception. Keep it separate from your own luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人へ少し待ってと伝えました。この袋を先に受付へ運び、回収担当へ渡してから合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人に待機を頼み合流前に回収袋を担当へ渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked my friend to wait a little. I will take this bag to reception first and hand it to the person in charge of collection before joining my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask your friend to wait and decide to hand over the collected bag before joining them. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の中に、扱いを確認したい物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is there anything in the bag whose handling you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 割れた物は入れていません。拾った紙と包装の袋です。ただ、ほかの参加者の袋の中までは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の回収内容と他参加者分の未把握を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not put anything broken in it. It contains paper and packaging bags I picked up. But I do not know what is inside the other participants' bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say what you collected yourself and that you do not know about other participants' bags. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身が集めた分としてお伝えください。次の担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please describe it as what you collected yourself. The next person in charge will check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の一袋を渡します。私の水のボトルも横へ置いていたので、それだけは回収袋と混ぜず持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一袋を渡し私物水を混ぜず持つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hand over my one bag. I had also set my water bottle beside it, so I will take that with me without mixing it into the collection bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over one bag and keep your personal water separate to take with you. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 清掃道具もお借りでしたら、こちらへ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you borrowed cleaning tools too, please return them here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道具も返しました。袋を引き継ぎ、私物の水と上着を持ってから友人の所へ休憩に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具返却回収引継ぎ後に私物を持って休憩へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I returned the tools too. After handing over the bag and taking my own water and jacket, I will go to my friend for a break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After returning tools and handing over the collected litter, take your belongings and go for a break. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。それでは、ゆっくりお休みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your help. Please enjoy your break. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆様の切符をまとめてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss everyone's tickets together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行きは三人ですが、帰りは私だけ早く帰ります。全員同じ往復の予定ではないので、自分の分から話してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人の往路と本人だけ早い復路を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are three of us going, but only I will return early. We do not all have the same round-trip plans, so may I start with my own ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the outbound trip for three separately from your own earlier return. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、ご本人の行きと帰りを伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First I will ask about your own outbound and return journeys.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行きは友人と同じ昼の便を希望します。帰りは家族との用事があるので、夕方までに帰れる候補を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の昼往路と家族用事による夕方帰着希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: For the outbound trip, I want the same midday service as my friends. For the return, I have something to do with my family, so I would like options that get me home by evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your own midday outbound preference and your wish to return by evening for family plans. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかのお二人は、今ここで帰りを決められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can the other two decide on their return journey here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ観光の予定を話しています。私がその人たちの帰りまで決めず、自分だけ先に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 観光未定の友人復路を決めず本人相談を先にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are still discussing their sightseeing plans. I will not decide their return journey for them; I will discuss only my own first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not decide the return journey for friends whose sightseeing is undecided; discuss your own first. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件に合う候補をご案内します。購入の前に、ご本人の予定を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show you options that meet your conditions. Please check your own plans before purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この候補なら家族との約束に合います。友人へ早く帰る理由も伝え、途中で一緒に帰ると思われないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補が家族約束に合い友人へ別復路理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This option fits my arrangement with my family. I will also tell my friends why I am returning early so they do not think I will return with them later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the option fits your family arrangement and tell your friends why your return journey is separate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご友人は、それぞれの希望が決まってからお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please have your friends contact us once each has decided what they want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人にもそう伝えました。私の行きと帰りを確認して購入し、友人の分は本人が決めてから別にお願いする形にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人のみ購入し友人券は本人決定後の別相談にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I told both of them that. I will check and purchase my own outbound and return tickets, and we will ask separately for my friends' tickets after they decide for themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Purchase only your own tickets and leave friends' tickets for a separate consultation after their own decision. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご本人の切符をご案内します。よいご旅行を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will help you with your own tickets. Have a good trip. Goodbye.
